steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow where auction awarding mode is configurable.
a priced single-stage event needs its type set before a template (the screen opens as RFP)
Apply the auction pricing template before adding line items.
Create the required event with two line items.
Complete the pricing sheet for both line items.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Invite two vendors so the awarding grid can contain multiple vendors.
Publish the configured line-item awarding event.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
Enter a bid for the first invited vendor so the event has a response.
Assert that the first vendor bid was accepted.
Enter a bid for the second invited vendor to populate multiple vendor columns.
Assert that the second vendor bid was accepted.
Close the published event so awarding is available.
Open the awarding grid for the closed event.
Assert that the awarding grid exposes the per-line vendor allocation control.
Assert that both line items and both vendors are available in the line-item awarding grid before allocation.
